notes.title: Age of War milestone - Update #3
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's been a while, but we're back with another update. And this is the big one! Before we discuss all the novelties we prepared for you, let us thank you for your awesome feedback, rulers. Your opinions have been instrumental in helping us craft a series of improvements to enhance your adventure. Rest assured, we’re [b]always keeping an eye on your ideas and comments[/b], and we deeply value your continued support in shaping the future of the game.


[b]And now - Update #3![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/593e662bef81c1e0667470bda9d13f51072a5292.png[/img]


[h2]Age of War Milestone - Update #3 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Major changes:[/h3]
• Added a new Sacrifices feature to enhance players' relationships with the gods
• Added information about the risk of sickness occurring
• Added new tooltip showcasing the house dwellers' happiness
• Added information about the produced and consumed goods balance in the production buildings
• Added a new consumption system that makes citizens use the given resource globally, instead of dividing its consumption to every single house
• Wide-ranging rebalance of the economy (resources extraction, production and services)
• Fixed a bug where Stables produced wood
• Fixed bugs related to saving and loading the game
• Improvements to the military units recruitment (faster recruitment time when more military buildings are available)
• Military units now travel faster
• From now on, only the available resources are visible in warehouses and on the panel at the top of the screen


[h3]Minor changes:[/h3]
• Added sound for destroying a building
• Added a new information icon when warehouses are full
• Added a new information icon when production buildings are out of needed resources
• Fixed an issue that caused warehouse workers to get stuck
• Fixed an issue where upgrading a building canceled its sickness status
• Fixed an issue with placing farms near farming buildings
• UI improvements to the Tactical Combat panel and a number of other UI improvements
• A number of other minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements
• Numerous optimization and visual fixes

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.title: Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Huge news, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Rejoice, emperors! Our journey through the Early Access phase is nearing its end, and soon we will all get to experience the [b]full version of the Builders of Greece project[/b]. While our road to this point has been bumpy and winding at times, thanks to your steadfast commitment, continued support, and invaluable feedback, we can now see the goal... and it's very near.


[h2]Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a0587f11d174dc6ee6872e0c766b2423895e71e3.png[/img]

That's right, [b]in just about 2 months[/b] you will be able to discover all the mechanics, features, scenarios, functionalities and surprises that we have prepared for you. Mark this special date on your calendars, builders, as May 6, 2025 you will sit on the ancient throne in all your glory. 

Know, that our team [b]does everything in its power to provide you with the best possible experience[/b] and irons out the last imperfections as we speak. We are aware that Builders of Greece is not yet completely problem-free, however, we are looking to the future with our heads held high, and we are steadfast in our efforts to ensure that everything goes smooth and according to plan. 

You can expect a lot of new interesting information on the full release soon, so as always - stay tuned!


[h2]Builders of Greece Age of War - Update #3 🛠️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The announcement of the release date does not of course mean that we will stop updating current game content. On the occasion of today's announcement, we would also like to present you the latest changes that have just appeared in our title!


[h3]Age of War - Update #3 changelog:[/h3]
• Added new translations of bonuses awarded by the gods 
• Fixed issues related to loading saved games
• Fixed issues with delivering goods by warehouse workers
• Fixed a bug that allowed to change units movement during their animation
• Fixed a bug that caused destroying a bandit camp to not complete the mission
• Fixed a bug that caused the deletion of a road leading to a warehouse to not display a “no road connection” icon
• Fixed bugs related to lags and stutters, and buildings / resources issues after loading the saved game
• Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of Chinese letters
• Fixed a number of bugs related to the gods system
• Fixed a bug that caused the Healer's House to not work properly and sick households to increase their happiness
• Fixed a bug that allowed to endlessly replenish one army squad
• Fixed a bug that caused the destruction of a field in an agricultural building not to affect its productivity and production time.
• Adjustments to the buildings' operation areas



[h2]Join the community 💭[/h2]

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.title: Sound the alarm! Age of War milestone is here ✊
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Can you hear it? The drums of war sounded once more! We are extremely excited to announce that another milestone on our path to full release has been reached. Behold, emperors - [b]the Age of War is here...[/b]

With this important event, we have a wealth of information we would love to share with you all, so instead of elaborating on the details, we’ll let the [b]changelog and the new Teaser[/b] 🤩 do the talking. "Age of War" is the biggest updates in the Builders of Greece history, so there is much to discuss. And what better way to showcase [b]so many changes[/b] than an epic gameplay video and changelog? Let's dive right in!


[b]🚨 PLEASE NOTE[/b] 🚨 Due to "Age of War" being the biggest patch so far, you may encounter unforeseen bugs and issues, for which we apologize in advance. After installing the update your saves will not work in the new version of the game, but you can still open them after changing the game branch on Steam to Legacy. As always - we appreciate your reports and suggestions on our Discord server. Thank you!


[h2]Age of War - Milestone Teaser 🎞️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=U2pvAM9uQw0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]But there's more! 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It would be difficult to show all the changes that came to the game with the new Milestone win just a one-minute teaser... but no worries, we got you! Thanks to [b]your feedback and awesome suggestions[/b], we decided to go one step further and tackle some important gameplay elements that we thought needed improvements or reworks.

Down below, you can see the [b]extended list[/b] of novelties, changes and improvements.


[h3]⚔️ Combat Related changes ⚔️[/h3]
- A completely new tactical combat system
- New scenario map - Age of War
- New units recruitment and management systems
- New units experience and ranks system with option of training troops in the Gymnasion
- New citizens rebellions system
- Bandit camps are now scattered across the maps
- Improved raiders mechanics


[h3]⚖️ Other changes ⚖️[/h3]
- New maps
- New civilizational milestones system
- Improvements to the citizens needs and social classes
- Improvements to the markets and acquisition of goods by citizens
- improvements to the game's economic balance
- Improvements to the Great Buildings and their influence on the city
- Rework of the work system, work efficiency, goods storage and the entire production system
- Rework of the sickness system
- Rework of the faith system
- Rework of the great people system
- UI improvements
- New camera movement options
- A huge number of other fixes, improvements, QoL changes and minor novelties


[h3]✋ Temporarily disabled or disabled✋[/h3]
- Trading system (work in progress)
- Economy panel (to be decided)
- Technology panel (replaced by civilizational milestones system and great people system)


Although the Age of War milestone brings a lot of news, it is not our last word. Our team is working on the [b]next crucial updates[/b], knowing that the release of the full version of Builders of Greece is already on the horizon. Stay tuned, Builders!

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the changes may not be apparent on the surface, we are tirelessly working behind the scenes to refine and evolve Builders of Greece. We know many of you are curious about the progress of this project 🤔 and we’re always excited to share what we’re working on. 

And so... we decided it is high time we tell you what changes await you in the game (really soon!) and what will come in the upcoming updates.


[h2]Learn more about the upcoming changes with the new video Showcase 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=lkmNpe1JaDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Novelties are coming! [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We are aware that the Builders of Greece project has huge potential, and our top priority is to unlock it, ensuring you have the most enjoyable gaming experience possible. And although the game still faces some important issues, we managed to identify them all and, we believe, resolve them.

Making a long story short, we carefully analyzed the feedback flowing to us from our community and drew the appropriate conclusions. As a result, we'll soon see innovations in gameplay elements such as economics, transportation, building, balance, production, military[b] and more![/b] 🛠️ 

[h3][b]What can you expect in the following patches:[/b][/h3]
➡️ New mechanic of Civilizational Milestones
➡️ New mechanic of Civil Rebellions
➡️ New mechanic of non-instant building construction
➡️ The new tactical combat system
➡️ Bandits threatening your empire
➡️ Changes in the citizen satisfaction system
➡️ Changes to dozens of basic game mechanics (balance, production, gods, diseases, transportation)
➡️ Numerous other cool mechanics we are brewing for you!


[h2]A word from the dev team 💭[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
At this point, we would like to thank you for your patience and continued support. We've been slowing down with updating Builders of Greece lately... but for a good reason. Now we are ready to significantly update the game, and subsequent patches will appear with greater frequency.

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Not so long ago, we celebrated the release of the "Great People" milestone presented on our Content RoadMap, but our work continues at full speed. [b]Thanks to your valuable feedback[/b], which you willingly share via Steam, social media channels and our Discord server, we have managed to prepare another significant Patch.

[h3]Brace yourselves, Rulers! Changes are coming...[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As usual, you can check out all the [b]new features summarized in our Patch Notes[/b]. However, we also invite you to the more descriptive part, which can be found below the novelties list 📜 There, we provide [b]more information[/b] about the changes introduced in the new update and explain in more detail how they will affect your empire and the people inhabiting it. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a7852732726eec08b34106258aa3faadcf36246d.png[/img]


[h2]Patch 0.10.0 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Added distinguished food preferences among different social classes and raised the amount of food that all classes eat

• Enhanced pathfinding algorithm for Storage Workers. Storage Workers now pick paths that are shorter and try to pick new ones after building new or destroying existing roads

• The player can now view the path of the Storage Workers more precisely after clicking them

• The importance of Agora and Marketplace has been increased. Houses outside their range (marked with an appropriate icon) cannot refill their local Pantry to its full value, which lowers the overall happiness level of specific social classes

• Performing basic rituals in religious buildings is now easier due to lowering amount and variety of resources needed

• Added new gods-devoted decorations, the construction of which slows down the decline in their Cult Points

• Better balance of prices of the goods when trading. Now every resource is properly valued, and the selling price is lower than buying one

• Changes to the random events - from now on they offer more detailed information, and their effects on gameplay have been rebalanced

• Merchants now inform the player about the goods they offer in advance, even when Polis don't have access to given good

• Wax and Wax Boards will be now more early-game resources

• Relocation of production buildings is now always available

• The number of current employees of the given production building (after its work was suspended) is now displayed correctly

• Enhanced transparency of the Workforce Panel in Economy Panel. Now adjusting priority and boosting specific buildings should be more clear

[h3]PLEASE NOTE 👇[/h3]
Keep a close eye on your city's food supplies after updating the game. The new Patch may cause them to start melting quickly as residents are now consuming more food!



[h2]And now - additional explanations 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As promised at the beginning of this entry, we’ve also prepared some [b]more in-depth details[/b] about the new changes. They will give you an even better understanding of what will happen in your city thanks to the Patch 0.10.0, so... [b]here they are![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3077e82705b53cd7471b2562382a428d9fc4c4f1.gif[/img]

[h3]The diet of your subjects 🐟[/h3]
We noticed that overflowing granaries in your Polis were a common sight, and therefore decided to increase the gluttony of each social group, which now prefers a particular type of food. The Thets are most likely to devour fish, representatives of the Zeugitai class relish red meat, and the Geomori may not refuse fish and meat, but it is wheat products that they like best.

[h3]Storage Workers 📦[/h3]
Storage Workers tirelessly move goods around your city, often so focused on their tasks that they miss the designated paths you've set for them. That’s no longer the case. Now, all Storage Workers will follow optimized routes to Warehouses and Production Buildings, responding to every new road created. 

[h3]Capricious Pantheon ⚡[/h3]
The Greek Gods can be capricious at times, but we understand that their anger was not something that should fall so often on your thriving Polis. To remedy this, we sent a delegation all the way to the top of Olympus and convinced each of the Gods to hold back their anger long enough for the city to spread its wings. Performing basic rituals in their name is now easier due to the lowering amount and variety of resources needed. Not to mention new sacred decorations that will slow down the decline in their satisfaction.

[h3]New trading prices ⚖️[/h3]
We have sent our chief economist on a mission to revalidate the prices of goods and resources in other cities, and now you can be sure that each of them is worth the right number of drachmas. It’s up to you to choose if your wealth will come from precious metals, large-scale raw material production, or by mastering a niche sector and trading the most advanced goods.

notes.title: Great People 🧑 The 2nd RoadMap Milestone is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The path was winding and full of surprises, but we’ve at last arrived at [b]the Second Milestone[/b] ✌️, everyone! We are truly thrilled to reach this point, as it marks the next stage in the carefully planned development of our flagship title – [b]Builders of Greece[/b].

And although we have already managed to implement some of its assumptions announced in our[b] Content RoadMap[/b] (we will talk about them below in a moment), there are also completely new features we want to show you. One way or another, our [b]wonderful guests[/b] will soon arrive at the gates of our city, so let's not delay any longer and get straight to the point 📜 [b]We don't want to keep them waiting, do we?[/b]


[h2]The Milestone Overview 📹[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=_nHsntsUsUw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Making a long story short - what's new? 🧐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If after seeing the Overview above you still feel like you want to [b]learn more about the latest Patch[/b], no worries - we got you! We know that many of you want to test the new features introduced with [b]the "Great People" Milestone[/b] right away, so we have prepared a short summary of the most crucial information:


[b]• Great People 👑[/b] - from now on, prominent Greek characters can come to your city, each influencing your society in a different, positive way

[b]• New Economy Panel 📈[/b] - Decide which buildings should work more efficiently and which may slow down. Grant or deny access to goods to your citizens, and manage production in your empire even more precisely

[b]• New events 📜[/b] - Random events are what make the gameplay more engaging and interesting. From now on, you can come across new (both positive and negative) occurrences

[b]• Building Relocation 🔄[/b] - We managed to implement this feature a few weeks ago. Thanks to it, you can freely move buildings that have already been built

[b]• Improved decorations 🌿[/b] - Similar to above, this enhancement is already present in the game. It allows you to decorate your city more accurately, which affects the well-being of your subjects


[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/d91ee3f209b58a99998de4f81963993e0054cfff.jpg[/img]
[/url]


[h2]Great People among the streets of your city 👦[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The arrival of notable, famous and simply powerful figures is [b]always good news[/b] for your empire, hence you should always make sure that they want to honor you with their presence. These finest among the people of Greece are highly desired by rulers across the land, so it is natural that they will choose only properly prepared cities as [b]the destination of their journey.[/b]

In the Great People panel, you will see a [b]list of requirements[/b] presented by each of the iconic figures. When you manage to fulfill it, you can be sure that they will soon knock on the gates of your city 🚪 When this happens, you can accurately track the patron's location and activity, and most importantly - their influence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/b72dca7889162a658a599602388ccc56b735d41e.gif[/img]

We don't want to deprive you of the pleasure of discovering new characters, so we will only say that they can influence, for example, the production efficiency, your relationship with Gods, research, the combat abilities of your units [b]and much, much more![/b]


[h2]The New Economy Panel 📊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We're excited to announce the arrival of [b]the new Economy dashboard[/b], as this's a feature you've been asking for in your reviews and Discord chats... and we are always happy to meet your demands 😁 We completely understand why you wanted us to implement it - it turns out that it is difficult to find a more precise and efficient way to manage the city's economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a72c0d1ff721d6912cd98bae1efca63958570c03.gif[/img]

With the Panel, for example, you can decide the [b]production efficiency of selected buildings[/b], grant or deny access to particular goods to different social classes, or assign additional workers to your warehouses. In addition, you can easily stop or resume the operation of selected workshops, farms and other useful buildings. [b]This is the power that a true Ruler deserves![/b]


[h2]New Events 📣[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The Random Event system is already well known to you, and now it's even more [b]engaging, random and unpredictable. [/b]The perverse fate that watches over your Polis may turn out to be [b]capricious or benevolent...[/b] and there is no way to anticipate its next move 🔮

Among the new events are, for example: medicine discovery, trade boom, grace of the Gods, or resource discovery. Sounds pretty friendly, doesn't it? Unfortunately, [b]there are two sides to every coin[/b], with the dark half being, for example: epidemics, pirate ships 🏴‍☠️, resource shortages or even overloaded goods destruction. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/148b4f560b4338007891e35920ca783d27cd74db.gif[/img]

[h1]Thank you for being with us, Builders 🤝[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
We are happy that we can share the moment of [b]achieving another Milestone[/b] with you, everyone. With each new update, patch and fix we are getting closer to the day of the full release of Builders of Greece, and thanks to your enormous support and helpful feedback, [b]this process can only speed up.[/b] 

[h3]Next goal - the Age of War Milestone... 💀⚔️ [/h3]

notes.title: The latest Patch - Blessing of Olympus - is now LIVE ⚡
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If you've seen our new [b]Early Access Content RoadMap[/b], you probably know that today, Builders of Greece will welcome some very special guests. Some of them are kind and caring, others do not shy away from violence... and all of them, without exception, are [b]extremely powerful![/b]

Without them, the culture and development of [b]Ancient Greece would not have been the same[/b]. And it's not just about wonderful temples, altars, or the godsfearing everyday life of all social classes 🙏 Shared beliefs helped cement communities, making it easier for them to work together and [b]pursue common goals.[/b] You and your subjects must also stand before the Gods to gain their favor... or ignite their wrath. [b]And so - let's welcome them to your Polis![/b]


[h2]It's time to meet your Patrons 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All of the Gods will gladly accept your prayers and appreciation. However, to effectively demonstrate your devotion, [b]you must first prepare an appropriate place.[/b] Religious buildings are perfect for this purpose, the first of which is the Altar. Once the [b]Altar[/b] or other building of this kind finds its place in your city, you will gain access to the new panel shown below 👇

[i](Click to expand)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6cb4872876c6c94fd2d777dc354612c8900e966c.png[/img]

In the Faith panel, you can see the [b]satisfaction of individual Gods[/b] and learn how they can help you with their favors. Each of the religious buildings can be dedicated to one of the Patrons, and it is up to you to forge your own mortals-to-Gods strategy! 

Will your Polis become a [b]place of worship[/b], or will you satisfy them with the[b] bare minimum?[/b] Will you commit to one particular God, or will you try to be on good terms with them all? 🤔 [b]The decision is yours alone[/b], and each choice will have its consequences... To make your task easier, we have prepared a short cheat sheet!

[h3]Each God excels in a specific area[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
🏹 [b]Artemis[/b] - Goddess of hunt, wild nature, moon and animals - thanks to her support, your ranged units will be more efficient in battle, and your Hunter's Hut will produce more meat

💕 [b]Aphrodite[/b] - Goddess of love, beauty and desire - with her help, your population will grow and reproduce faster, providing you with a stable influx of new subjects

🍇 [b]Dionysus[/b] - God of wine, theater and ecstasy - through his passion for celebration, he will help you prepare important rituals that other Gods will surely appreciate

🔥 [b]Hephaestus[/b] - God of fire and craftsmanship - thanks to his divine endurance and strength, Hephaestus improves the combat potential of your infantry units

😇 [b]Hestia[/b] - Goddess of family, travelers and newborns - her kindness and caring nature strengthens the bonds between the inhabitants of your city and allows more of them to fit under the roof of one house


[h2]Rituals and the fury of the Gods ⚡[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7bd7add01b9b4ac5f97c72297e246911368639b3.gif[/img]

The most effective way to win a God's favor is by [b]performing special rituals[/b] in a dedicated place of worship. Preparing such rituals is often time-consuming and can be expensive, as the appropriate goods are needed to carry them out. Nevertheless, as you already know, [b]it is a profitable investment.[/b] Especially since ignoring the jealous Ancient Gods is not a good idea...

[h3]The Gods can show their displeasure in various ways - and none of them are good for your city! 😱 Angry Patrons may, for example:[/h3]

• scare animals away from your hunting grounds
• cause a plague of infertility
• spark off the degradation of tools and valuable items
• turn other divine beings against your Polis
• cause random houses to fall into ruin... 

And unfortunately, there may be more such negative effects! ☠️ With that in mind, be sure to carefully [b]plan your relationships with the inhabitants of Olympus[/b].


[h2]Improvements to the Technology system 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the introduction of the Faith system is the biggest change in today's Patch, [b]it is not the only one.[/b] Based on your feedback, we also decided to make a number of changes to another very important feature of the game, namely the [b]Technology system. [/b]

An overhaul of the Technology system is aimed at increasing its influence on the game throughout its course 🧐 This means that your [b]development decisions will now have an even greater impact[/b] on how your entire Polis performs. [b]Moreover[/b], from now on you have the possibility to choose the development path that [b]best suits you[/b], which was not so strongly emphasized before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/f5d2cb0443434c2b834469309a84a6eb32960793.gif[/img]

More specifically, the Technology system has been divided into two kinds of perks: [b]basic and elite[/b] ⭐ The first of them is necessary to push your city forward, while the latter will show their full potential in the mid and late game. [b]Thanks to precisely adjusted gradation[/b], elite perks will affect areas such as various production modifiers or the improvement of combat units.


[h2]New Maps 🗺️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you, eager for new challenges, asked about new maps. We have done our best to fulfill this request, and so... we're happy to announce that with today's update, [b]two new unexplored lands have appeared in Sandbox mode[/b]! And this is by no means the end - we will soon present you with even more maps, both in Scenario and Sandbox modes. [b]Explorers, rejoice![/b] 😁

[b]• Olympus Island[/b] - land of plateaus and plains, with a few gentle descents to the blue sea. A perfect place to build a vast, powerful Polis stretching to the horizon. If you dream of a city built at different heights, this place is just perfect.

[b]• Hera Island[/b] - this unique island boasts a long, straight shoreline that can be used for maritime trade and fishing. Inland stretches a vast plain, the edges of which are marked by high, inaccessible yet majestic mountains.

Thank you for your time, Builders! We wish you many new awesome adventures in the mystical world of Ancient Greece. [b]May the Gods bless you all! [/b]🙏

notes.title: Builders of Greece EA - Coming on 27 Feb 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders! 🏛️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This is the news we've all been waiting for! Rejoice, Rulers, as in just 7️⃣ days [b]Builders of Greece in its Early Access version will hit the Steam store! [/b]

We acknowledge the mixture of excitement and joy behind today's announcement, and we are sure that you must have many, many important questions... Well, you can trust that we will not leave them unanswered! This is why we have collected a set of basic questions that we answer in the form of [b]Early Access Q&A.[/b]

The answer to the first and most important of them can be found in the title of this post, but we think we should repeat it clear and out loud: [b]Builders of Greece Early Access is coming on 27 Feb 2024! [/b] All right, now that we have your curiosity and attention, let's dive into the Q&A! 🤓


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/ec504c4d96744d7a81d588c39dc94d4d68e89b07.png[/img]

[h2]Early Access Q&A 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]1. Why did you choose to publish on Early Access?[/h3]

Acknowledging the enthusiastic response of players towards Builders of Greece, we want to invite all the interested players to actively contribute to the development of our game, while offering them a substantial glimpse into the rich experience awaiting them in the full version. 

Based on our experience, we firmly believe that providing players with the direct opportunity to play the title remains the optimal approach to gather valuable feedback and deepen our interactions, which would not have been possible without launching the Early Access version of the game. Making a long story short - we want to constantly improve our title, without taking away your ability to play it. We consider it a win-win situation! 
[hr][/hr]
[h3]2. When do you plan to publish the full version of the game?[/h3]

Our target timeframe falls within about 6 to 12 months, although we are committed to exerting maximum effort to release the full version of Builders of Greece as soon as possible. We will do our best to make sure you don't have to wait long!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]3. What are the differences between Early Access and the full version of the game?[/h3]

In its initial stages, the Early Access version will not offer the full range of mechanics and features that will appear in the full version of the game, however with subsequent patches and Early Access development, Builders of Greece will be enriched with additions such as the weather system, new Campaign Mode missions, expansion of player's City to neighbouring islands, Gods/Faith system, new buildings and military units, even more useful tools, extended technology tree and more! Your feedback and suggestions on how to improve Builders of Greece are of utmost importance to us, and we're eagerly awaiting them all!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/66093e35d4e47d77fde2b7c16f8f6a5ef8e6bfe7.gif[/img]


[h3]4. What's the Early Access content?[/h3]

The Early Access version offers the main Campaign Mode (the first scenario) and the Sandbox Mode. The first of them will be a narrative scenario that immerses players in the amazing world of Ancient Greece, providing them with an epic adventure full of varied missions, fateful choices, bloody clashes and smart planning, while the latter will allow players to build their own city without any instructions or specific missions. 

Our main goal is to frequently patch and enrich the game with new content, of course in accordance with players' feedback. According to our plans, such patches will be implemented approximately every three to four weeks. Ultimately, the Early Access version will feature all the main systems and mechanics we planned for the full release, but initially they will not be fully developed and will evolve gradually over time.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]5. How much will it cost? Will I be able to play the full game after its release?[/h3]

Yes! Purchasing the Early Access version will give you access to the full version of the game in the future. As a token of appreciation for players who contribute to advancing and refining our game, we assure that the Early Access version will be priced lower than the complete edition. The Early Access price is still to be announced.

[h3]6. How can I help you develop the game?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Our community has already proven many times how enthusiastic and energetic it is in helping us develop our title. We believe that thanks to the Early Access version, our player base will increase by thousands of people from all over the world, and as a result, we will receive another portion of very important feedback. 

Players can share their feelings about Builders of Greece via Steam Discussions, our very vivid Discord server, and through numerous Social Media channels. Moreover, previous experiences have demonstrated the effectiveness of dedicated Feedback Forms, which our testers enthusiastically complete. Our intention is to continue this practice.


[h2]Only 7 days left![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you everyone! We hope you are as hyped as we are and that you can't wait for [b]Feb 27[/b]! Be sure to stay up to date and follow our [url=https://twitter.com/home]communication channels[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb]Discord Server[/url].

[hr][/hr]
The Agora is the very first building to appear in your city. The cool thing is that [b]it evolves along with your Polis[/b] - wile looking quite inconspicuous and modest at first, over time it will transform into a wonderful, rich structure surrounded by a beautiful colonnade! 🏛 To achieve this, you must meet many important conditions... but this is the whole other story. 

What are the main functions of Agora? Well, many calls this place the very [b]heart of the city[/b]. The area around the Agora is always crowded with your subjects who want to replenish their supplies, transport some goods, or just pass by and go about their business. Although being the center of the settlement is a very important role, Agora was created for another [b]crucial purpose[/b]. Ok, everyone! Grab your baskets, bags and pouches - it's time to browse some wares 📦


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/49bf0a2a4ff42cbb52aa0bed123935c1cb301077.png[/img]


As a wise ruler, you must know, that Agora serves as a kind of [b]warehouse-marketplace[/b], full of all kinds of goods. Whenever your people's pantries are empty, or when they need other important items, you can be sure that they will direct their steps right to the Agora 🦶 Porters are constantly delivering more and more goods here, filling in the gaps, so that their fellow citizens can enjoy undisturbed [b]access to a variety of things[/b] that they need in their everyday life. Whether it's clothes, food, tools or other wares, a huge part of them can be found right in this place. What an efficient system!

In the later stages of the game, when your city will stretch to the horizon, some of the Agora's responsibilities will be taken over by [b]Marketplaces.[/b] It just would be difficult for residents of more distant residential zones to make long marches to the Agora to grab their goods. Nevertheless, it is the Agora that will always remain the [b]center point of your city[/b] 👇 and will be counted among the most beautiful, glorious buildings under your control. We like to think of it as one of the most practical and well-thought-out systems in all of Ancient Greece!


[h2]Flour as an essential ingredient 🥖[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The agricultural revolution, especially the ability to grow grain, completely changed humanity. The cessation of the nomadic lifestyle meant not only better reproductive conditions, but also technological development. One of the effects of such development is the Mill - an [b]indispensable element in grain cultivation and processing.[/b] It is thanks to this unique building that it is possible to [b]produce flour[/b], which became the basis of the diet of many ancient cultures. But how does actually an ancient Greek Mill work? And how can it contribute to the task of feeding your population? [b]Let's take a look![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3681777524a26ba4d074c0fcb8151ab91d92ebc1.png[/img]


It all starts with the grain we mentioned above. Without it, valuable flour could not be produced! Your farmers spend long hours in the field to sow, tend and ultimately harvest this valuable resource. The ripe [b]grain then goes to the Mill[/b], where experienced millers begin their work 🤲 This is where the grains are ground into fine, pure flour. To do so, your Mill workers pour them onto a special stone table and then grind them using a huge, heavy, rotating stone. As you can see, such work requires patience and physical strength, but... it's definitely worth it!

White flour is an essential ingredient in all [b]baked goods[/b] made in your city, and it is used by such places as Bread Bakery or Tiganites Bakery. It is thanks to them that fragrant, filling bread reaches the tables of your subjects 😜🍞 [b]Bon appétit! [/b]


In the following parts of the series, we will return with descriptions of many other cool structures that will ensure the safety, well-being, and development of your city. We hope that the buildings presented today will find their place among the streets of your Polis, and that they will contribute to the growth of your magnificent empire! 😀 [b]As always - thank you and stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Architect's Corner #13 - Healer’s House & Pharmacist Workshop
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the next part of our "Architect's Corner" series, in which we tell you all about [b]the buildings you will have at your disposal as a ruler of an ancient Greek Polis[/b]. Discover interesting tips and tricks, learn how to effectively plan the development of your city, and check out how many useful structures you can raise - all this to the glory of a great ruler, such as yourself! 👑


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]



[h2]To help those in need 😷 [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The spear of a hostile raider, the jaws of a wolf, a fall from a high cliff, a turbulent sea, and storms were just a few of the many dangers that[b] threatened the lives [/b]of the ancient Greeks. But sadly - there's more! As civilization developed and larger cities emerged, new threats joined the existing ones. Among them... [b]diseases and plagues[/b] 🤢

Fear not, however, because as a mighty ruler, [b]you can tame[/b] most of the deadly threats that endanger your people and save them from harm! Today, we'll take a peek into the medical background of your empire and learn more about how its healthcare system operates. Let's go!


[h2]Primary care physician - Healer's House 🩹 [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although the medical knowledge of our ancestors was rather... let's say - underdeveloped, [b]the doctor is still counted among the oldest professions[/b] in the world. For centuries, people have tried to help their dear neighbors and ease their pain and suffering. And that's what your town Healer does! People in need of basic medical care are knocking on the door of his house, so the Healer can identify and solve the problem of his patients ❤️ How does he do it?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6bde76d818d8b343c7de0cfc376e4e635db39106.png[/img]


A great help in Healer's work is his good friend, the Herbalist. Thanks to the herbs grown and properly processed by the Herbalist, Healers can [b]"do their magic"[/b] to help those in need 🌿 These conscientious specialists are the first line of defense against diseases and plagues that, if left unchecked, can [b]decimate your city's population![/b] 😱 Don't underestimate the effectiveness and usefulness of the Healer - although its practice is simple, it most often turns out to be very effective.

However, sometimes even a Healer's awesome abilities are not enough. What then? 


[h2]Pharmacist Workshop 💊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Aside from the Healer's House, your subjects can rely on the support of the Clinic. The medical services offered at the Clinic are fairly similar to those provided at the Healer's House, however they [b]can reach a larger number of your people[/b] 🤕 This state of affairs it's not solely due to the presence of more seasoned physicians, but also to the fact, that the Clinic uses more advanced Medicines. And this is where the [b]Pharmacist Workshop[/b] comes in handy! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/fac116f539b2e8199d573d9da7e943892ae456f8.jpg[/img]


It certainly won't come as a surprise that [b]Pharmacist Workshops[/b] are involved in producing precious Medicines. On the other hand, what might astonish you is that despite operating millennia ago, the drug-making process was remarkably sophisticated and efficient. To produce Medicines, you will need a substantial list of ingredients, including [b]Vinegar, Herbs, and Olive Oil 🏺[/b] Quite an array of components! Furthermore, these ingredients must be consistently supplied to the Pharmacist Workshop to ensure the well-being and health of your population.

Nevertheless, it is an essential investment if you want [b]your Polis to boast hundreds[/b], if not thousands, of residents! 💪

In the following parts of the series, we will return with descriptions of many other cool structures that will ensure the safety, well-being, and development of your city. We hope that the buildings presented today will find their place among the streets of your Polis, and that they will contribute to the growth of your magnificent empire! 😀 [b]As always - thank you and stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: The Ruler's Manual #10 - Hygiene
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings, mighty Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Any ruler who wants to [b]go down in history[/b] 📚 should get acquainted with the "Ruler's Manual" series! Why - you ask? Well, in the following entries we tell you about how to make your Polis wealthy, safe, and as prosperous as possible. And believe us, it's [b]not as easy as it may seem! [/b]


[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]
[hr][/hr]

Life in Ancient Greece, while full of wonderful adventures, was not one of the safest or easiest. In addition to famine, wars, and hostile, wild lands, the inhabitants of the city-states also faced other threats. One of the biggest and [b]most dangerous of them are diseases[/b] 🤢 Since humans began to form civilizations, and thus live in larger groups, diseases have spread more easily and quickly than ever before. Sadly, this was the price our ancestors had to pay for being part of a developing society.

The good news is that epidemics, though they can put an end even to a thriving, prosperous Polis, can be [b]controlled and even prevented[/b]. Today we will learn how to manage the hygiene of your subjects to ensure their health and a good, long life 💖


[h2]What are the dangers of the lack of hygiene among your subjects?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's not like the people of your city don't want to be clean and tidy - not at all! They will gladly take every opportunity to wash off the dirt and [b]feel fresh and neat[/b] 🧼 It is therefore important to give them the opportunity to use facilities that will allow them to take care of hygiene. It should not come as a surprise, that a neglected, dirty society is the perfect environment for disease and epidemics to spread. [b]And this is something we want to avoid![/b]

Know that your empire may suffer severely if an epidemic breaks out in the streets of your Polis. Many of your subjects may then choose to emigrate or succumb to disease and cross the dark [b]river of Styx[/b] 💀


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/e70a26d3103483f255cd9466042d0b4a1fadccb8.png[/img]


Let's not be dramatic, though, as there is a way to avert these dark visions! Most of these dangers are nothing that [b]the good old Baths[/b]💦 - so much loved by the ancients - can't handle. A visit to this building is a great way to cleanse your body after a day's work and return to the desired freshness. In addition, the Baths uses precious Cosmetics that simply are loved by your subjects. 

Baths' purpose is to help keep the living part of your society clean and healthy. As cruel as it sounds, none of its members will live forever. That is why we are putting one more building at your disposal. This gloom structure will allow you to [b]stave off diseases[/b] and provide an eternal resting place for those who have passed away.



[h2]Necropolis and it's noble purpose[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As we mentioned at the beginning of this entry, [b]life in Ancient Greece was not very safe[/b]. Wounds sustained in combat, hunting, or travel often turned out to be serious enough to send the injured person to the other side 😫 Not to mention hunger or infections. In such a situation, the Ancients had to learn how to [b]handle the bodies of the dead[/b]. If they buried them just anywhere, they would quickly expose themselves to numerous diseases and health problems.

The Necropolis is a place where your citizens can bury their loved ones[b] in a safe and reverent way[/b], without fear of carrying a negative impact on the health of their fellow citizens. Specially anointed and prepared bodies are deposited in the Necropolis vaults, where the deceased spirits can enjoy [b]eternal feast and spring in the fields of Elysium[/b] 🍹 Drinks all around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/4b3b3f07906a2b8a25d2c1da82df62be75819ce3.png[/img]


And what if, despite all your efforts and the provision of appropriate infrastructure, your subjects fall ill? This is certainly an undesirable situation, but there is a way out of it as well. In such cases, the services of physicians stationed at [b]Healer's House and Clinic[/b] will be very useful! 💊 They can fight both the initial and more developed stages of the disease, and restore your inhabitants to health and good shape. However, we adhere to the principle - [b]prevention is better than cure![/b] If you provide your city with the right conditions to take care of its hygiene, your subjects will surely repay you with diligence, loyalty and high morale! 🤓


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/4298398c49c9f7873ea5e3fc4039cf81b36a8e65.png[/img]

In the following parts of the series, we will return to you with descriptions of many other important mechanics and tips that will help you become the greatest ruler of all time! [b]As always - stay tuned.[/b]


--

notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the next part of our "Architect's Corner" series, in which we tell you all about [b]the buildings you will have at your disposal as a ruler of an ancient Greek Polis[/b]. Discover interesting tips and tricks, learn how to effectively plan the development of your city, and check out how many useful structures you can raise - all this to the glory of a great ruler, such as yourself! 👑


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]



[h2]Useful, fashionable and beautiful - clothes of your empire 🧵 [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
One of the most important differences between humans and other inhabitants of our planet is... the [b]concept of clothes and fashion[/b]. And although it may seem a bit funny and obvious at first, there is a lot of truth in this statement!  Even the first representatives of our species covered their bodies with primitive clothing, and over time we took this art to a much higher, more advanced level.

Your Greek empire also has its own unique take on clothes, and it's your job as a ruler to make sure none of your people is... naked 😁


[h2]It all starts with a good material - Weavery 👏[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The whole clothing adventure begins at the Flax Plantation, where your farmers harvest the precious Flax. Making a long story short, after proper care and collection, the excavated material goes to the Weavery. Everyone in the industry knows, that long, strong [b]Flax fibers are just perfect for further processing[/b]! 🧐 And that's what the Weavery does - with the right tools, knowledge and technology, the workers of this building turn the raw plant into beautiful, useful bales of [b]Linen.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/b7eb3c459b3337adfb2c15ce911ce7a96463be4d.png[/img]


It is not without reason that Linen is one of the most frequently used materials for the production of clothes (from ancient times until today!) [b]Linen is very strong[/b], absorbent, and dries faster than cotton. Because of these properties, linen is comfortable to wear in hot weather and is valued for use in garments! No wonder that many civilizations have taken a liking to this type of fiber.

However, cloth alone, [b]no matter how great[/b], will not turn into beautiful, colorful robes by itself...


[h2]With needle and thread - Tailor Workshop 🥼[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Now that we have provided our tailors with the right materials, we can start the actual work! It is within the walls of their workshop that [b]beautiful robes[/b], which later decorate and protect the bodies of your subjects, are created 🤩 We all associate their unique clothing style with airy, long robes and tunics. Without a doubt, this is a very interesting and simply beautiful style, but most importantly, it is practical and perfectly suited to [b]the hot climate of Greece.[/b] No question, our ancestors knew what they were doing! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/de713c5bd7d3e977285cfecc508c03babbea77fd.png[/img]


Constant access to clothes and robes will definitely speed up the development of your city. [b]Some social classes require this commodity [/b] in order to function and continue to advance. Keep this in mind when planning the expansion of your Polis, as higher social classes are necessary for this purpose. In addition, robes are a valuable trade item 🤑 and selling them will certainly help you to fertilize your treasury or acquire other valuable goods!

In the following parts of the series, we will return with descriptions of many other cool structures that will ensure the safety, well-being, and development of your city. notes.title: The Ruler's Manual #9 - Random Events
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings, mighty Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Any ruler who wants to [b]go down in history[/b] 📚 should get acquainted with the "Ruler's Manual" series! Why - you ask? Well, in the following entries we tell you about how to make your Polis wealthy, safe, and as prosperous as possible. And believe us, it's [b]not as easy as it may seem! [/b]


[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]
[hr][/hr]

Make no mistake, life in Ancient Greece was full of surprises! For what would the life of a ruler be if it were completely predictable and organized? 🎲 Huge celebrations, hostile raids, weather changes, or social problems may fall on you completely unannounced, which can change the whole course of your empire's history. Who knows? Perhaps such events will save your city from trouble... or on the contrary - they will plunge it into chaos and destruction. Either way, we believe [b]the Random Events system[/b] makes your adventure with Builders of Greece even more attractive and replayable!

Today, we will learn more about how to deal with such Random Events and try to predict the unpredictable. Here we go! 😀


[h2]Random Events are both an opportunity and threat[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Let's start with the fact that [b]it's not like all Random Events that happen to your empire are bad or harmful.[/b] Not at all - some of them can benefit your society in a significant way. Needless to say, your [b]subjects will be delighted once they happen[/b]! Positive Random Events are a great break from the long days full of work and other daily errands, so keep your fingers that they will occur once in a while. 

We are sure you're curious what positive, unexpected events you can count on 🧐 You better get ready to [b]praise Gods, host some ancient celebrities, and feast![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/32d8a995fa7fc7cc3139f6108b3b3e35eb964516.png[/img]


All right, let's get to the point. Among the positive events that can affect your city, we can mention the [b]treasure hunt[/b]! Well... maybe not "exactly" a treasure hunt, but if you're lucky enough, your builders may come across the unusual find. During the construction of a new building, their shovels can hit strange wooden containers 😲 

The dirt beneath your city turned out to[b] hide buried treasure[/b], which is most likely a remnant of the former inhabitants of this land. You could keep it to expand your empire's treasury or distribute it to citizens to show them your kindness. What it will be? The choice is yours!

Positive events can also result from grassroots, social needs. From time to time, the residents of your Polis need a break from hard work and their daily errands. And what is better to forget about the hardships of everyday life than a [b]Festival?[/b] 🥳 Of course, the final decision whether the festival will take place or not rests on your shoulders. Will you be willing to let the city celebrate? Remember, that [b]satisfaction and joy of subjects come at a price[/b] - for a while your workshops, farms, and other production buildings will suspend their work, not to mention the coins that you will have to spend to cover the costs of this great event.

If you want to expand your city even further or need extra hands to work, [b]you can count on Refugees.[/b] At random times, they may knock on the door of your palace and [b]ask for shelter.[/b] If you decide to accept them, they will become your loyal subjects and happily devote their skills for the glory of the empire 🏠 Before you offer them a home, make sure you have the right conditions to do so! We don't want that extra mouths to feed ruin your supplies, do we?


[h2]You never know what to expect[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Of course, there is also the other sides of this coin and some of the Random Events pose a threat. Let's take a closer look at the most obvious one, which is [b]enemy attack on your town[/b]. The rulers of neighboring city-states may see their opportunity in plundering your wealth for themselves and decide to launch an assault on your Polis ⚔ Such attacks are always fateful, so be sure to keep a strong, numerous army!

The whim of the gods can be just as dangerous ⚡ From time to time, the soothsayers may inform you that the rough sea is a sign of [b]Poseidon's wrath[/b]. Whatever the reasons for the high waves, going to sea is not the best idea at the moment. But what about our brave fishermen? And how long can your city last without one of the main sources of its food - fish? Time will tell...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/c281ae6d05966fea045020c9f41913b7db770dd8.png[/img]


Another difficulty facing the ruler is public discontent. If famine, high taxes, poverty, or other serious problems occur in your empire, [b]people may take to the streets and chant against your reigns.[/b] To make things even worse 🔥 riots are generating more and more damage with each passing moment. 

In this situation, there are only two ways out - appease them with silver or violently suppress the subversives.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/21a5a3208749e398f82c9e798a6c2fe5f3d2b2c4.png[/img]


[h2]How to deal with Random Events[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Unfortunately, some events are completely [b]out of your control[/b]. However, there are a few rules that will help you control their effects! To mitigate the damage caused by Random Events, you should always keep your treasury full of coins, your warehouses and granaries full of goods, and keep your people safe and happy. Sounds easy, right? 😏 Right...


In the following parts of the series, we will return to you with descriptions of many other important mechanics and tips that will help you become the greatest ruler of all time! [b]As always - stay tuned.[/b]

Without these cute insects, our ancestors would quickly empty their granaries, not to mention that refilling them would be very difficult. In addition, bees are the producers of two unique natural goods - honey... and [b]wax![/b] 🧐

Today we will check how the second of them contributed to the flourishing of ancient civilizations and how you can use them as a ruler of a Greek Polis!


[h2]Let's start from the beginning - Apiary 🌷[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This is where all the bee magic begins! 🐝😁 If you were passing by the apiary, you would certainly hear a characteristic buzzing sound. This noise is nothing else than the sounds of the industrious insects that set off on a journey in search of flowers, shrubs, and other similar plants. When they settle their affairs with greenery, they return to their hive - aka the Apiary. 

[b]It is there that they produce wax[/b], which, not surprisingly, was considered a very desirable product in the ancient world. But why were our ancestors willing to pay so much for this unique commodity? 🤔


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/1e37faa0b36f631c2bf1dbd44dc0e498e996b0c9.png[/img]

Your beekeepers and other numerous citizens of your empire surely know the answer. Wax tablets - because that's what we're talking about - were suitable for personal notes, drafts, and temporary records ✍️ as they were easy to carry and could be reused by melting and smoothing the wax surface. They were widely used for personal correspondence, educational purposes, and administrative tasks. Who would have thought, right?


[h2]Tablet Makers Hut 📒[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
These tireless artisans specialized in crafting the unique good of [b]wax tablets.[/b] Thanks to their skills and specialized tools, they were able to coat the board with wax so that you could write or draw on it. Pretty smart! 📜 As we mentioned, such tablets were used by a [b]wide range of ancient specialists[/b]. Mouseion, Temples, Asklepiejon, or Theaters simply couldn't do without them! Needless to say, these buildings are considered a symbol of ancient Greek civilization, and it was thanks to them that society was able to thrive!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/b0500d90073f704f517fa91bb388a456bf3e1dd4.png[/img]

Your empire will also benefit from the presence of Apiary and Tablet Makers Hut. In fact, they may not be essential, but they will certainly [b]come in handy in the further stages of the game[/b]. After all, a ruler that does not care about the cultural and spiritual sphere is doomed to failure!

notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the next part of our "Architect's Corner" series, in which we tell you all about [b]the buildings you will have at your disposal as a ruler of an ancient Greek Polis[/b]. Discover interesting tips and tricks, learn how to effectively plan the development of your city, and check out how many useful structures you can raise - all this to the glory of a great ruler, such as yourself! 👑


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]



[h2]Farm animals and their importance to your empire[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Since the dawn of time, mankind has been [b]closely associated with various kinds of animals[/b]. Initially, our ancestors hunted animals to obtain their skins, bones, and above all - meat 🍖 However, as the centuries passed, in addition to risky and dangerous hunting, we have learned to tame and (in a way) cooperate with wild nature... and this is how [b]livestock farming[/b] joined our practices!

The Ancient Greeks naturally also benefited from animal husbandry. And while it's not as easy as it seems, you, as efficient rulers who want to ensure the prosperity and sustenance of their subjects, will also have to take advantage of animal farms! Today we'll take a look at the homesteads of two of them and find out how they can help your empire grow. Here we go! 👩‍🌾


[h2]Goats 🐐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
These playful, curious, and lively creatures are among the first domesticated animals in history. Goats are famous for not being too picky when it comes to their menu 😁 this is undoubtedly a great advantage facilitating their breeding. However, it was not because of the fairly simple breeding and cheerful appearance of these animals that people decided to tame them. It turns out that goats produce nutritious milk that is just [b]ideal for consumption![/b] 🍽 Moreover, goat's milk is highly valued by cheese makers and bakers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/167a08589aeff207ed613ca7cd6f7480d4be0f48.png[/img]

And this is how goat's milk is used in your city. Cheese makers turn this precious commodity into delicious, fragrant cheeses, which then end up on the tables of your subjects 🧀 As you know from our previous posts, a varied diet is good for your citizens' morale, so make sure you have plenty of goat's milk in your supply.

Milk is also used in the baking of [b]traditional Greek Tiganites[/b]. In addition to flour and olive oil, it is one of the main ingredients of this meal. Needless to say, Tiganites are one of the favorite dishes of your people, and the beautiful aroma coming from the bakery certainly makes them feel better... and hungrier!


[h2]Cattle 🐄[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Cattle are perhaps the world's most common large livestock animal. Of course, they must not be missing in your Polis as well! 🐮 These calm animals spend their days grazing on green grass and roaming around their enclosure, however despite their peaceful nature, they cannot be left unattended. [b]The task of your farmers [/b]is to ensure their safety, and good conditions for growth and reproduction. 

Although the time from when a calf turns into an adult cow may seem quite long, the benefits of owning these animals make their work worthwhile. If your farms fill up with cattle, you can be sure that you will not face such dangers as a deadly famine! ☠️ Ok, now that we know what farmers' work looks like... it's time to get our hands dirty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/08b66f545c5f7cc60ab08f0a646d2bc3d39a1a0f.png[/img]

[b]Mature cattle are sent to the Slaughterhouse[/b]. The butchers working there are engaged in obtaining meat from the cows, which is a very important element of the diet of your subjects. It is certainly not a clean and pleasant job, but butchers know how important their profession is 🔪 With a constant supply of [b]nourishing meat[/b], your citizens have the strength to spend their days in the mines, workshops, service buildings, or to train their combat skills in the barracks.

It is worth noting that Hunting Lodges are also a great source of raw meat. You can learn more about them in our previous entry [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1273100?emclan=103582791467350167&emgid=3344500789281244515][b]right here »[/b][/url]

notes.title: The Ruler's Manual #8 - Taxes
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings, mighty Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Any ruler who wants to [b]go down in history[/b] 📚 should get acquainted with the "Ruler's Manual" series! Why - you ask? Well, in the following entries we tell you about how to make your Polis wealthy, safe, and as prosperous as possible. And believe us, it's [b]not as easy as it may seem! [/b]


[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]

There comes a time in every citizen's life when he has to [b]share some of his coins[/b] with those in power. As long as such a fee is fair and does not drain the pockets of a citizen, and his superiors provide him with appropriate living conditions, protection, and development opportunities, we can agree that it is a pretty well-functioning system 🤝 The problems begin when the ruler gets greedy and loses the balance between the amount of taxes and the mood of his subjects.

Today, we will learn how to [b]keep this balance[/b] and make sure that no one in your city (including you!) feels disadvantaged. Off we go!


[h2]What are taxes and how do they work[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The tax system is one of the oldest social contracts known in history. Landowners, kings, rulers, administrators, or simply the strongest warriors around periodically [b]knock on the commoners' door[/b] and demand a fee 💰 In return, payers can work on their land, enjoy protection, and a judicial system.

Things are no different in your city. From time to time, another portion of taxes paid by your subjects will flow into your treasury. We are sure you will not be surprised when we say that [b]coins (called Drahmas) are one of the most important resources[/b] you will have an occasion to manage. Without them, you won't be able to pay for the construction of new buildings, as each of them, in addition to typical building materials like wood and stone, naturally requires a portion of shiny Drahmas.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/43440cdf80da73b6f62710027c71aa2e973ade69.gif[/img]


In addition to expanding the city with new buildings, money will come in handy when raising an army. Each unit under your command must be trained and then maintained, which of course comes at a cost. Such costs depend on the advancement and type of unit. A large army,[b] while a guarantee of security[/b], can purge your treasury of coins. On the other hand, an underfunded, small army may not be able to cope with a hostile invasion. 

The cost of maintaining buildings works on a similar basis. Each workshop, theatre, farm, or service building you build has its own upkeep cost ⚒ Only when your money supply allows you to pay such a cost, will they work properly and unhindered.


[h2]Taxes and society[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The interests of the ruler and his subjects are not always identical in this case ⚖ People prefer to pay lower taxes and keep more money for themselves, while the rulers would like to maximize their income and impose higher fees on society. Finding a [b]balance between tax rates and social satisfaction[/b] is one of the biggest challenges you will face. Fortunately, the panel you will use while playing Builders of Greece allows you to quickly change the fees charged... however, it is their deep understanding that is most important here! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3d2928f6db6b401baeb4439948db93ab338091c6.png[/img]


Let's start with the benefits of setting low taxes. Your subjects will certainly appreciate your generosity, which will positively affect their attitude toward your authority. In addition, low fees can encourage other local people to settle in your city 🏛 However, such a situation may result in a loss of financial liquidity, which may disrupt the entire production chain in your Polis and lead to the disintegration of the army. The lack of funds also means an inability to further develop the city.

Let's check what lies on the opposite side of this financial scale. What happens if you set high taxes? Well, your treasury will soon be filled to the brim with coins, and you won't have to worry about the state of your army and the fee for the functioning of buildings under your control. What you will have to worry about, however, is the [b]satisfaction of your subjects,[/b] who may want to leave the city of such a greedy ruler or even cause riots! As you can see - the right balance is everything!

To make it easier for you to choose the right amount of taxes, you can use the following formula:
[b]Total Income = Tax Income - Building Maintenance Cost - Army Maintenance Cost[/b]


[h2]How to maximize your taxes?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Fortunately, there are ways to increase tax revenue while maintaining good relationships with taxpayers! The most important one is to increase the population of your city. After all, everyone who lives in it must contribute to the budget 💵 To do this, you must make the Polis you manage [b]attractive to new settlers[/b] and convince the current residents to stay in it for a longer time. Access to services, education, development, safety, varied goods, culture, or entertainment are just a few of the conditions that you must meet to achieve this. During the game, you will discover the nuances of efficient empire management - and [b]if you prove to be a good student[/b], you might be able to get hundreds of people to settle down in your city. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/318d86ee62c122bdd3b01751598cb6008364b194.png[/img]


In addition to the number of your subjects, their social status is also important here. As you know, richer families are obligated to pay more taxes. Therefore, their smooth development should be added to the list of your tasks. If you provide your subjects with the right conditions for development, [b]their social status will start to grow[/b], and with it the stream of coins flowing to your treasury. The richest households of your empire can turn out to be a great source of income!

In the following parts of the series, we will return to you with descriptions of many other important mechanics and tips that will help you become the greatest ruler of all time! [b]As always - stay tuned.[/b]

That means you can expect lots of reports on new systems, features, mechanics, or upgrades, but also numerous cool news about characters, places, items, and visual improvements. We are sure that everyone, even a beginner in the world of video games, will easily understand what we do and how it's done. Although game development requires a lot of different skills and knowledge, as a player you don't need to have them all to enjoy great titles, right? 😁


[h3]👉👉 [url=https://blumentmt.com/devblog]Visit our devblog HERE[/url] 👈👈[/h3]

We divide the whole thing into specific projects, therefore if you are only interested in one of our titles, you can only read about it. [b]We also use short, clear headlines[/b] and separators. notes.title: Architect's Corner #9 - Barracks and Archery Range
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the next part of our "Architect's Corner" series, in which we tell you all about [b]the buildings you will have at your disposal as a ruler of an ancient Greek Polis[/b]. Discover interesting tips and tricks, learn how to effectively plan the development of your city, and check out how many useful structures you can raise - all this to the glory of a great ruler, such as yourself! 👑


[url=https://discord.gg/8KnCYpm2xT][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk to the community and developers about the game![/h3]



[h2]Attention! The enemy is coming[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Although one can say that Ancient Greece is a beautiful, sun-drenched, or even idyllic setting, in reality it is not without its problems. One of the biggest and most dangerous of them is [b]hostile aggression on your territory[/b]. Just imagine - you struggle to build your own empire from scratch. You gather more and more wealth, give a home to new citizens, develop technology and production. And then... you spot hostile units on the horizon 😱 Make no mistake, they want to invade your city and grab your resources for themselves.

We talked about the [b]war system[/b] in the last part of our "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1273100?emclan=103582791467350167&emgid=3676662189797908603]Ruler's Manual[/url]" series, so today we will focus on [b]two basic military buildings[/b] that will allow you to recruit the defenders of your Polis. We'll take a look at the Barracks and Archery Range and check how your soldiers' training is going - let's go, commander!

[h2]Barracks ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Fighting is a difficult craft, where every single mistake can prove fatal. That is why only prepared and properly trained units are sent into battle. The most basic military building is [b]Barracks[/b]. It is on the yard of this building that your soldiers practice spear and shield fighting or learn discipline and following orders 💪 Barracks allow you to train units relatively quickly and cheaply [b](however not only)[/b] from the early stages of the game. Over time, as your empire grows stronger, you will be able to afford to build more Barracks which will result in even faster unit training and recruitment. It's up to you whether you choose a large, but rather simple army, or elite yet quite expensive veteran troops. [b]Speaking of which...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/acca8dac20e7d87327dd85ad65eb417415b190e4.png[/img]

The simplest unit, requiring the least resources and training, is the so-called [b]Psilos[/b]. The Psilos ranks consist mainly of commoners equipped with a simple shield, a bronze-tipped spear, and leather shin guards. Due to their poor armor and rather simple training, their strength lies in number, not quality.

The next, fairly more advanced type of infantry is the [b]Hypaspist[/b]. Their heads are protected by helmets, and their torso is covered with a simple armor, and a bronze-plated wooden shield. The Hypaspist also wields a long bronze-tipped spear 👊

The most dangerous units that can join your ranks are the [b]Hoplites[/b]. Their entire body is protected by a bronze armor and a solid, round shield. You can also identify them by a flashy crest on their helmets and long coats. Hoplites are equipped with swords 🗡 but their weapon of choice are double-ended spears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/97bd08d41a559a324df635f31f5acc3764fc848d.jpg[/img]


[h2]Archery Range 🏹[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In addition to classic infantry, you can also rely on ranged units, which are excellent at striking enemies from long distances. They need special conditions to maximize their skills and effectiveness, so that when the time comes, they will be ready to eliminate the foreign threat. Fortunately, [b]Archery Range[/b] is just perfect for this purpose! The architects made sure that this unique building includes long shooting tracks, targets to practice accuracy, and an observation tower 👀 Just like Barracks, the Archery Range is one of the basic buildings that you will be able to build in the early stages of the scenario. Well then, let's see what awaits the recruits who visit it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/c9ea1525751770f7f209566b84d39c659cc37a64.png[/img]

Once again, we'll start with a description of the most basic ranged unit. The only task of the [b]Slingers [/b]is to shower the enemy forces with a barrage of stones fired from their weapons. Their equipment consists only of a tunic, a bag, and an iconic slingshot. It is a very cheap and quick-to-train unit.

Let us take a closer look at [b]Toxotes [/b]🎯 shooters equipped with deadly bows and arrows. They are known to be a terror of battlefields, as their attacks are very effective and can strike down entire enemy squads. Be sure to protect them from melee attacks, and they will surely prove their worth.

The most versatile range formation - the [b]Peltast [/b]- uses formidable javelins. Such a javelin, thrown with enough force, can literally crush an incoming opponent 💀 In addition to that, the strong points of the Peltast are their strong armor and high durability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/278026e2b1bb1c14271fe73db718fa96a1dfe406.jpg[/img]

In the following parts of the series, we will return with [b]descriptions of many other cool structures [/b]that will ensure the safety, well-being, and development of your city. We hope that the buildings presented today will find their place among the streets of your Polis, and that they will contribute to the growth of [b]your magnificent empire![/b] 😀 As always - thank you and stay tuned!
